problem: If $M=[\begin{aligned}t & 5 \\ t & 9\end{aligned}]$ is a singular matrix, calculate the value(s) of $t.$
worked_solution:
The matrix $M$ is singular if and only if $det(M)=0.$ Calculating the determinant, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =t\cdot 9-t\cdot 5 \\  & =9t-5t \\  & =4t\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we set the determinant equal to $0$ and solve for $t:$

$$
\begin{aligned}4t & =0 \\ t & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the value of $t$ is $t=0.$
